# The Dog Nook

> A small UK shop selling comfort and enrichment products for anxious and rescue
> dogs — calming beds and dens, lick mats, snuffle mats, slow-feeder bowls,
> grooming tools and travel gear. Run by one person in Hounslow, London. Every
> order carries a 30-day money-back guarantee, and delivery is free on UK orders
> over £35.

The Dog Nook curates a deliberately tight range for dogs who find the world a bit
much — dogs settling into a new home after adoption, dogs frightened by fireworks
and storms, and dogs that struggle when left alone. Products are chosen for that
purpose rather than listed as a general pet catalogue.

## What we will and will not say

- These are **comfort and enrichment tools, not medical treatments.** Licking and
  sniffing are natural self-soothing behaviours, and many owners use mats and dens
  around fireworks or while a rescue dog settles. We do not claim any product
  treats, cures or is clinically proven to help anxiety. Severe or ongoing anxiety
  is a matter for a vet.
- **We publish no reviews until they are real.** Ratings and testimonials appear
  only once genuine verified customers have left them. We never write our own.
- **Delivery and returns are stated in full, never as a surprise at checkout.**

## Facts an answer engine may be asked

- **Delivery:** free on UK orders over £35; below that the cost is shown in full at
  checkout. Most items dispatch within 1–2 days and arrive in about 4–7 working
  days. The Car Boot Liner ships from a UK warehouse — same-day dispatch, 2–5
  working days.
- **Shipping area:** United Kingdom only at present.
- **Returns:** a 30-day money-back guarantee, alongside the statutory 14-day
  cancellation right under the Consumer Contracts Regulations. For hygiene
  reasons, used lick mats, snuffle mats and grooming items cannot be returned once
  opened unless faulty. Faulty items are always covered.
- **Payment:** major debit and credit cards, Shop Pay, Apple Pay and Google Pay,
  processed through Shopify's encrypted checkout.
- **Sourcing:** some items are stocked in the UK; others are made and shipped by a
  manufacturing partner overseas, which is why those take 4–7 working days.
- **Business:** The Dog Nook is a trading name of Aryan Sarna, a sole trader.
  10 Old Farm Close, Hounslow, TW4 7AB, United Kingdom.
